{{Short description|Greek modern pentathlete (born 1976)}}
'''Katalin Partics''' (born October 22, 1976) is a [[Greece|Greek]] [[modern pentathlon|modern pentathlete]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Katalin Partics|url=http://www.uipmworld.org/athlete/katalin-partics|publisher=[[Union Internationale de Pentathlon Moderne]]|accessdate=December 27, 2016}}</ref> She competed in the women's individual modern pentathlon events at the [[2000 Summer Olympics]], in which she placed [[Modern pentathlon at the 2000 Summer Olympics – Women's|22nd]], and the [[2004 Summer Olympics]], in which she placed [[Modern pentathlon at the 2004 Summer Olympics – Women's|16th]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Katerina Partits|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/pa/katerina-partits-1.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418030942/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/pa/katerina-partits-1.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=April 18, 2020|website=Olympics at Sports-Reference.com|publisher=[[Sports Reference]]|accessdate=December 27, 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Sydney 2000 / Modern Pentathlon: Individual Competition Women|url=https://www.olympic.org/sydney-2000/modern-pentathlon/individual-competition-women|publisher=International Olympic Committee|accessdate=December 27, 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Athens 2004 / Modern Pentathlon: Individual Competition Women|url=https://www.olympic.org/athens-2004/modern-pentathlon/individual-competition-women|publisher=International Olympic Committee|accessdate=December 27, 2016}}</ref>
